attribution.scope: TWSE institutional 20-day study, 2024-2026 through 2026-10-02; TPEx full common matrices absent locally
attribution.weights: equal stock weights inside day, equal weights across the same complete days

operating_pilot.selection_reason: two Taiwan pure-play foundries with public quarterly earnings releases and US SEC filing routes; availability cohort, not representative stock universe
operating_pilot.quarters: 2023Q1 through 2025Q4 inclusive, all 12 consecutive quarters each
operating_pilot.target: next-quarter consolidated gross margin percent; EPS/revenue only secondary extraction checks
operating_pilot.evaluation: 2024Q1 through 2025Q4: up to 8 paired forecast targets per issuer; no fitted ML on this tiny pilot
operating_pilot.source_gate: require exact issuer/version, numeric and accounting-basis consistency, verifiable historical document and timestamp route; no website observation timestamp substituted for historical publication
operating_pilot.failure_gate: missing or ambiguous source/time/version stays a gap; do not fit stock-return model; report source feasibility instead
operating_pilot.claims: SEC acceptance is not Taiwan first disclosure; dated issuer PDF is not proof of full revision history; no trading returns or alpha inferred
